# opnsense_telegraf_output (Resource)

Telegraf output plugins (**Services ▸ Telegraf ▸ Output**, plugin `os-telegraf`): InfluxDB v1/v2, Elasticsearch, Graylog, Prometheus, Datadog, MQTT, OpenTelemetry and more. This is a singleton: import it with the ID `telegraf_output` before managing it. Attributes left unset keep their current value.

## Example Usage

```terraform
import {
  to = opnsense_telegraf_output.this
  id = "telegraf_output"
}

resource "opnsense_telegraf_output" "this" {
  influx_v2_enable       = true
  influx_v2_url          = "https://influx.example.com"
  influx_v2_token        = var.influx_token
  influx_v2_organization = "infra"
  influx_v2_bucket       = "opnsense"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `datadog_apikey` (String, Sensitive) Set the API Key for accessing Datadog.
- `datadog_enable` (Boolean) This will enable Datadog output.
- `datadog_url` (String) Set the URL where metrics shoud be sent to. Format is without square brackets, just like https://app.datadoghq.com/api/v1/series.
- `elastic_enable` (Boolean) This will enable Elasticsearch as output. Format is without square brackets, just like http://192.168.0.1:9200.
- `elastic_indexname` (String) Set the index name.
- `elastic_password` (String, Sensitive) Optional HTTP basic authentication details for Elasticsearch.
- `elastic_timeout` (Number) Write timeout (for the Elasticsearch client), formatted as a string. If not provided, will default to 5s. 0s means no timeout (not recommended). `-1` when unset; set `-1` to clear it.
- `elastic_url` (String) Set the URL where metrics shoud be sent to.
- `elastic_username` (String) Optional HTTP basic authentication details for Elasticsearch.
- `graphite_enable` (Boolean) This will enable Graphite as output. Format is without square brackets, just like localhost:2003.
- `graphite_prefix` (String) Set an optional prefix to the metrics.
- `graphite_server` (String) Set the IP and port where metrics shoud be sent to. Format: IP:port.
- `graphite_ssl_disable` (Boolean) This will disable SSL/TLS connection to Graphite host. Default is encrypted connection.
- `graphite_tagsupport` (Boolean) This will enable support for tags.
- `graphite_template` (String) Use a specific output template. For usage see https://github.com/influxdata/telegraf/blob/master/docs/DATA_FORMATS_OUTPUT.md.
- `graphite_verify` (Boolean) This will enable verification of a secure connection to Graphite. Default is disabled for compatibility reasons.
- `graylog_enable` (Boolean) This will enable Graylog as output. Format is without square brackets, just like localhost:12201.
- `graylog_server` (String) Set the IP and port where metrics shoud be sent to.
- `influx_database` (String) Set the name of the database on InfluxDB.
- `influx_enable` (Boolean) This will enable InfluxDB as output. Format is without square brackets, just like http://192.168.0.1:8086.
- `influx_insecure_skip_verify` (Boolean) This will skip chain and host verification.
- `influx_name_prefix` (String) Specifies a prefix to attach to the measurement name, formatted as a string.
- `influx_password` (String, Sensitive) Set the password for authentication.
- `influx_timeout` (Number) Write timeout (for the InfluxDB client), formatted as a string. If not provided, will default to 5s. 0s means no timeout (not recommended). `-1` when unset; set `-1` to clear it.
- `influx_url` (String) Set the URL where metrics shoud be sent to.
- `influx_username` (String) Set the username for authentication.
- `influx_v2_bucket` (String) Set the name of the bucket in Influx v2.
- `influx_v2_enable` (Boolean) This will enable InfluxDB v2 as output. Format is without square brackets, just like http://192.168.0.1:9999.
- `influx_v2_insecure_skip_verify` (Boolean) This will skip chain and host verification.
- `influx_v2_organization` (String) Set the name of the organization in Influx v2.
- `influx_v2_timeout` (Number) Flush timeout for the v2 Telegraf output in seconds, formatted as a string. If not provided, will default to 5. 0 means no timeout, but is not recommended. Increase if you get timeout errors. `-1` when unset; set `-1` to clear it.
- `influx_v2_token` (String, Sensitive) Influx v2 authentication token.
- `influx_v2_url` (String) Set the URL where metrics shoud be sent to.
- `mqtt_client_id` (String) Client ID, if not set a random ID is generated.
- `mqtt_data_format` (String) Data format to output. Defaults to "influx". One of `carbon2`, `cloudevents`, `csv`, `graphite`, `influx`, `json`, `msgpack`, `nowmetric`, `prometheus`, `prometheusremotewrite`, `splunkmetric`, `wavefront`.
- `mqtt_enable` (Boolean) This will enable writes to a MQTT Broker acting as a mqtt Producer.
- `mqtt_insecure_skip_verify` (Boolean) Use TLS, but skip chain and host verification.
- `mqtt_layout` (String) Data layout to output. Defaults to "non-batch". One of `non-batch`, `batch`, `field`.
- `mqtt_password` (String, Sensitive) Set the password for authentication.
- `mqtt_qos` (String) QoS policy for messages. 0 = at most once, 1 = at least once, 2 = exactly once. Defaults to 2. One of `0`, `1`, `2`.
- `mqtt_retain` (Boolean) When selected, metrics will have the RETAIN flag set.
- `mqtt_servers` (Set of String) URL of MQTT brokers. Format is without square brackets, just like localhost:8083 or mqtts://server.net:8883. The same credentials will be used when defining multiple brokers.
- `mqtt_timeout` (Number) Timeout for write operations. Default is 5s. `-1` when unset; set `-1` to clear it.
- `mqtt_topic` (String) MQTT Topic for produced messages. if left blank, will default to [ mqtt_topic_prefix/{{ .Hostname }}/{{ .PluginName }} ].
- `mqtt_topic_prefix` (String) MQTT Topic Prefix - Will be overidden by the Topic if defined below.
- `mqtt_username` (String) Set the username for authentication.
- `opentelemetry_compression` (String) Set the compression mode. One of `gzip`, `none`.
- `opentelemetry_enable` (Boolean) This will enable OpenTelemetry as output.
- `opentelemetry_header_name` (String) Name of an additional HTTP header to send with requests, e.g. Authorization.
- `opentelemetry_header_value` (String) Value for the custom header, e.g. Bearer your-token-here.
- `opentelemetry_insecure_skip_verify` (Boolean) This will skip chain and host verification.
- `opentelemetry_server` (String) For gRPC, set the address and port, e.g. 192.168.0.1:4317. For HTTP, use a full URL, e.g. https://collector.example.com/v1/metrics.
- `opentelemetry_timeout` (Number) Write timeout, formatted as a string. If not provided, will default to 5s. 0s means no timeout (not recommended). `-1` when unset; set `-1` to clear it.
- `prometheus_enable` (Boolean) This will enable Prometheus as output.
- `prometheus_exclude` (String) Collectors to enable, valid entries are "gocollector" and "process". If unset, both are enabled.
- `prometheus_listen` (Number) Port to listen on. `-1` when unset; set `-1` to clear it.
- `prometheus_stringaslabel` (Boolean) Send string metrics as Prometheus labels.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Always `telegraf_output`.
